_comment: Hand-checked rules that replace the passport-index defaults. Key: passport ISO code, then destination ISO code (or SCHENGEN). Every entry needs src (official page) and checked (YYYY-MM-DD). The twice-yearly routine extends this to every destination.

AD.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180; passport must stay valid at least 3 months after you leave Andorra.

AE.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days; for tourism the passport must have at least 6 months validity left.

AF.note: Visa required in advance from an Afghan mission; none on arrival; no stay length stated.

AG.note: No visa for visits of up to 90 days within 180 days.

AL.note: Visa-free for 90 days within 180 days counted from first entry; ID card also accepted.

AM.note: Visa-free for up to 180 days within one year (read as 180 in any 365 days).

AO.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; passport must be valid for more than 6 months; no stay length stated.

AR.note: Page says both 3 months and 90 days for tourist stays; counted here as 90 in any 180 (stricter reading).

AU.note: Visa required before travel; types and stay length are in the Australian visa finder.

AZ.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days; entry by air only because land borders are closed to Serbian citizens.

BA.note: No visa; up to 90 days counted from entry; ID card or passport accepted (children need a passport).

BB.note: No visa for a stay of up to 90 days.

BD.note: Visa required in advance (Serbian page names the Bangladesh embassy in Rome); passport valid 6 months; no stay length stated.

BF.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BH.note: A visa is required and can be applied for online as an e-visa; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BI.note: A visa is required (from the Burundi embassy in Paris); the Serbian page states no length of stay for ordinary passports.

BJ.note: A visa is required (apply on the official e-visa site); the Serbian page states no length of stay for ordinary passports.

BN.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BO.note: A visa from a Bolivian mission is required; the stay may be extended up to 180 days in a single year (initial stay not stated).

BR.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days, extendable by 90, but no more than 180 days per year counted from first entry; work is not allowed.

BT.note: A visa is required and is arranged through a registered Bhutanese tour agency; no stay length stated.

BW.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

BY.note: Visa-free for up to 30 days per stay and 90 days per calendar year; longer stays need a visa.

BZ.note: A visa is required; the Serbian page states no length of stay.

CA.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; the page states no maximum stay.

CD.note: Visa required for ordinary passports, plus a yellow fever vaccination certificate; no stay length stated.

CF.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; passport must be valid at least 6 months (counted as 180 days) and a yellow card is needed.

CG.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; the 90-in-180 days rule on the page applies only to diplomatic and official passports.

CI.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; no stay length stated.

CL.note: Visa-free for stays of up to 90 days.

CM.note: Visa required for ordinary passports; no stay length stated.

CN.note: Visa-free for stays of up to 30 days from entry in mainland China; an electronic entry card must be completed.

CO.note: Visa-free for up to 90 days, extendable by another 90, within 180 days in a calendar year.

CR.note: Visa-free for up to 3 months (entered as 90 days); the page asks for passport validity of at least 6 months for tourist travel.

CU.note: Visa required, applied for online; no stay length stated for ordinary passports and passport must be valid at least 6 months from entry.

CV.note: Visa required for ordinary passports, obtained via the Cabo Verde embassy in Brussels; no stay length stated.

DJ.note: Visa required, with single-entry visas available via the government eVisa site; no total stay length stated.

DZ.note: Visa required from the Algerian embassy in Belgrade with no eVisa or arrival option; no stay length stated for ordinary passports and passport valid 6 months after travel.

EC.note: Visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days.

EG.note: Visa required; the page says stay up to 90 days but also that the tourist visa is valid 30 days, so no day limit is entered.

ER.note: Visa required, obtained through the Eritrean embassy in Rome; no stay length is stated.

ET.note: Visa required, obtainable at the Ethiopian embassy in Rome or online at evisa.gov.et; yellow fever certificate required and no stay length is stated.

FJ.note: Visa-free; passport must be valid at least three months after departure from Fiji and no maximum stay is stated.

FM.note: Visa-free for a stay of up to 90 days.

GA.note: Ordinary passports need a visa (an e-visa at evisa.dgdi.ga is valid only for arrival at Libreville airport); yellow fever certificate required and no stay length is stated.

GB.note: Visa required and must be obtained before travel through TLS in Belgrade; no stay length is stated.

GD.note: Visa-free for Serbian passport holders; no stay length is stated.

GE.note: Visa-free entry and stay for up to one year; travel health insurance is required from 1 January 2026.

GH.note: Visa required via the Ghana e-Visa platform; passport must be valid 6 months from planned return, yellow fever certificate required, and no maximum stay is stated.

GM.note: Visa required for national passports; no stay length stated.

GN.note: Visa required from the Guinean embassy in Rome (no eVisa or visa on arrival); no stay length stated for ordinary passports, passport should be valid 6 months.

GQ.note: Visa required from the embassy in Rome; the 90-day visa-free stay applies only to diplomatic and official passports; yellow fever card required.

GT.note: Visa required and not available at the border (US visa holders exempt); the 90-day visa-free stay is only for diplomatic and official passports; passport valid 6 months.

GW.note: Visa required from the embassy in Brussels (no eVisa or visa on arrival); no stay length stated, passport should be valid 6 months.

GY.note: Visa required for Serbian passport holders; no stay length or passport validity stated.

HK.note: Visa-free for up to 14 days per the Serbian MFA China page, which covers Hong Kong SAR. Hong Kong Immigration Department says this applies to biometric Serbian passports only.

HN.note: Visa required, issued for 30 days with possible extension of another 60 days; passport valid 3 months beyond the stay.

HT.note: Visa required; no stay length stated, passport must be valid 6 months after the visa expires.

NP.note: Tourist visa on arrival (15/30/90 days, extendable); at most 150 days per calendar year (January–December).

TR.note: Up to 90 days in a period of 6 months counted from the first entry (counted here as 90 in any 180, the stricter reading). Passport valid 150 days from entry.
